name: NarixaSoft Short URLs
author: narixasoft

sections.description:
Automatically creates a short code for every published post and page. Short URLs
use the /go/code/ format and redirect visitors to the public content URL. You
can copy, edit, or regenerate a URL from the post editor. A link icon in the
admin bar provides quick actions for the page currently being viewed.

Usage

Activate the plugin from Plugins.

Open or edit a post or page.

Use the Short URL panel to edit the code, copy, open, or regenerate the link.

The plugin registers and refreshes rewrite rules when it is activated.

Global Management

Go to Settings → Short URLs to view all generated URLs. Each row lets you
edit the code or delete the short link without deleting the content.
